description:
Reference population, generation 2026-08-17, revised after the 2026-08-18 audit.
maker_inventory_limit is set explicitly at 5000 ABC. It defaults to 100, and at that value the population collapses: over eight hours ABC/USD falls 17.9%, CDF/USD peaks at +763% and ends +196%, and the ABC/CDF cross loses 90%. At 5000 all three books are stable within a few percent. A parameter that swings the outcome by twenty times must not be an unstated default (E-257, E-259).
taker_fee_bps is now explicit at its default of 5, because it silently redefines the triangular threshold: the desk requires its configured edge plus one fee per leg, so edge_bps 5 with a 5 bps fee means 20 bps, which is the value E-238 rejected as leaving the desk inert.
maker_inventory_skew_bps 3 and maker_hedge_interval 60s are carried forward, but note that the experiments choosing them (E-214, E-216, E-231) ran in a population that no longer exists, and the 3-versus-5 ordering sits inside the seed spread (E-232).
noise_order_qty 5e7 with a 1.5 Pareto tail gives a mean order of 1.5 ABC against a 5 ABC quote, not the 0.5 ABC an earlier description claimed. Only the directional finding survives: order size relative to quoted depth governs price formation. The specific pair is not calibrated (E-243 corrected, E-247, E-255).
triangle_arb.lot_qty is 0.5 ABC, a tenth of the maker quote. At the previous 0.05 the desk filled 53,157 orders and still left triangular parity 84% away with the cross book locked at two prices; at 0.5 the median deviation is 0.3% and the cross tracks its legs. Fifty times gives no further improvement, so the requirement is roughly a tenth of quoted depth (E-262).
